products.product_description: The refrigerated vacuum packed hot smoked oysters, Original flavor, is sold in 2.5 oz. or 4 oz. packages. There is no UPC for this product. The product main label is read in part "***T&S OYSTER FARM NETARTS BAY***SMOKED OYSTERS***NET Net Weight 4 oz (113g) ***PERISHABLE KEEP REFRIGERATED AT OR BELOW 38***Cert. # OR-179-SP 703 Ivy st. Tillamook OR 97141***".
products.product_quantity: 73/4 oz. packages; unknown amount for 2.5 oz. packages
products.code_info: Pull Dates of AUG 1 2013 to OCT 6 2013
products.reason_for_recall: T & S Oyster Farms brand refrigerated vacuum packed hot smoked oysters, Original flavor, is recalled due to the potential contamination with Clostridium botulinum.
